title: The Third Rare Relic
summary: Surrounded by the phantom heralds of the Three Demon Lords, Ha-Jun fuses the Fang of Abyss and Chains of Ruin in combat, mastering the complete triad of Rare Relics.

panels.shot: three 500-foot demon lord phantoms in sky wide shot
panels.action: Three titanic demonic faces loom in the cosmic black clouds over the floating island: Iron, Shadow, and Void.

panels.shot: demon lord malgath voice booming like thunder
panels.action: Lord Malgath's horned iron visage speaks: 'The mortal child who broke my gates... Hand over the relics and your death will be swift.'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: JHUK JAO, MORTAL INSECT! RELICS KO DEMON KINGS KE HAWALE KARO!

panels.shot: demon lord valac shadows creeping across the ground
panels.action: Lord Valac's shadow tendrils slither across the crystal grass like living ink, trying to trap Ha-Jun's boots.

panels.shot: queen lilith voice whispering in thousand echoes
panels.action: Queen Lilith's masked void face whispers seductive poison: 'Join us, young Sovereign... Rule beside us instead of dying alone.'

dialogue.speaker: lilith
dialogue.text: Tumhare bhai ko hum eternal youth denge... Bas Crown ka rasta humein de do.

panels.shot: tae-jun shouting from behind ha-jun
panels.action: Tae-Jun shouts with burning fury: 'Unki baat mat sunna, Ha-Jun! Yeh sab jhooth bolte hain!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Unhone saari promises todi hain! Inhe sirf tumhari power chahiye!

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling with razor-sharp contempt
panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his chin upward, his dual-ringed eyes and cosmic galaxy eye shining with sovereign scorn.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Rule beside you? Heh. First Sovereign ke killers ke saath baithne ka mujhe koi shauq nahi hai.

panels.shot: malgath phantom roaring in insulted fury
panels.action: Malgath's iron visage roars: 'INSOLENT BRAT! SHADOW LEGION, ERASE HIM!'

panels.shot: hundreds of shadow phantom assassins dropping from sky
panels.action: From Valac's dark clouds, five hundred elite Shadow Assassins in bone masks dive like a black meteor shower.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping forward with chains of ruin uncoiling
panels.action: Ha-Jun unspools the heavy black chains from his torso, spinning them in a 20-meter perimeter circle.

panels.shot: activating 20x gravity field within perimeter
panels.action: The moment the chains touch the ground, a localized 20x gravity field crushes everything within 20 meters.

panels.shot: first hundred shadow assassins slammed to earth
panels.action: The first hundred diving assassins are caught in the gravity well, slammed flat into the moss like pancakes.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing fang of abyss in right hand
panels.action: In his right hand: the spatial void dagger; in his left hand: the master gravity chain link.

panels.shot: ha-jun launching chain with dagger attached to tip
panels.action: Ha-Jun loops the void dagger onto the end of the chain, hurling it like a devastating kusarigama.

panels.shot: spinning void scythe cutting dimensional rifts
panels.action: The spinning dagger at the end of the chain slices circular tears through space itself 360 degrees around him.

panels.shot: three hundred shadow assassins bisected in midair
panels.action: The spatial chain scythe shreds through three hundred shadow assassins in three seconds, erasing them into smoke.

panels.shot: kuro swooping down with violet flame breath
panels.action: Kuro bathes the remaining ground forces in violet hellfire, clearing every last assassin from the island.

panels.shot: the island meadow cleared of all enemy forces
panels.action: In under thirty seconds, the entire 500-assassin legion is completely eradicated; silence returns.

panels.shot: the three demon lord phantoms flickering in shock
panels.action: The three titanic phantoms flicker, their smug superiority replaced with genuine, terrifying apprehension.

dialogue.speaker: valac
dialogue.text: Chains of Ruin aur Fang of Abyss ko ek saath link kar diya...? He mastered two rare relics simultaneously?!

panels.shot: ha-jun recalling the chain with a sharp snap
panels.action: Ha-Jun snaps the chain back into his hand, the void dagger locking seamlessly into his palm.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at the sky phantoms
panels.action: Ha-Jun points the Fang of Abyss directly at Malgath's 500-foot eye in the clouds.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh tumhara best tha? Phantoms bhejna band karo aur khud aao.

panels.shot: lilith phantom narrowing eyes with venomous hatred
panels.action: Queen Lilith's masked phantom hisses: 'You are walking to your own funeral, boy. The Crown will destroy you.'

dialogue.speaker: lilith
dialogue.text: The Fallen Throne will become your tomb!

panels.shot: three phantoms dissolving back into storm clouds
panels.action: The three colossal demonic avatars dissolve into swirling black clouds, leaving the twin moons glowing again.

panels.shot: dawn sunlight of the demon realm breaking through
panels.action: The black clouds part; ethereal violet morning light bathes the floating crystal island once more.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up beside ha-jun smiling proudly
panels.action: Tae-Jun claps Ha-Jun's shoulder firmly, laughing with tears of pure, proud joy.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Hahahahaha! Unke 500 elite soldiers ko 30 second mein khatam kar diya! Incredible, Ha-Jun!

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling warmly at his brother
panels.action: Ha-Jun's battle intensity melts away, returning to the gentle younger brother: 'Aapse seekha tha, Bhai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aapne hi toh sikhaya tha ki bullies ke saamne kabhi jhukna nahi chahiye.

panels.shot: kuro landing on a rock between them
panels.action: Kuro nods approvingly: 'Ab rasta clear hai. Rare Relics ka triad complete ho chuka hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Agla stop: The Sovereign Citadel of the Fallen Throne. Wahan Legendary Crown hamara intezaar kar raha hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun pointing toward north horizon
panels.action: Tae-Jun points toward a colossal jagged mountain peak shrouded in lightning ten miles north.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Wahan... Mount Obsidian ke apex par The Fallen Throne hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking toward the distant mountain
panels.action: Ha-Jun's Eye of the Night pierces the clouds, spotting the golden-violet glow of the ancient throne.

panels.shot: ha-jun expanding his shadow wings wide
panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his wings, offering his back to Tae-Jun once more.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chaliye, Bhai. Apne Sovereign Crown ko lene chalte hain.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun taking flight toward mount obsidian
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun rocket into the violet morning sky toward Mount Obsidian, twin moons shining behind them.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Throne par chahe koi bhi baitha ho... Ab yeh kahani mere terms par khatam hogi.
